consolidated_vs_standalone.value: STANDALONE ONLY - no consolidated financials exist
consolidated_vs_standalone.evidence: The Q1 FY27 covering letter says 'Please find enclosed, the Un-audited standalone financial results along with limited review report thereon'. The notes state 'The company is operating in a single reportable segment... All activities are carried out within India' per Ind AS 108. No subsidiary, associate or joint venture is disclosed, and the Annual Report records no downstream investment ('The company neither have any Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) nor invested as any Downstream Investment in any other company in India').
consolidated_vs_standalone.note: screener.in exposes a /consolidated/ URL for this scrip that renders a page with empty price and market-cap placeholders. A crawler that treats the existence of that URL as evidence that consolidated figures exist will produce a blank or a phantom second basis for a company that has only ever reported standalone.

traps.lakh_vs_crore_scale: The PRIMARY filing is denominated 'INR in lakhs' - Q1 FY27 profit after tax reads 70.02, meaning INR 70.02 lakh = INR 0.70 crore. Aggregators restate to crore. A pipeline that ingests the filing PDF and assumes crore (the more common Indian reporting unit for larger companies) overstates every figure by 100x: a INR 2.19 crore FY26 profit becomes INR 219 crore, which would exceed the company's INR 77 crore market cap by 3x and imply a PE of 0.35. This is the single highest-value scale trap in this name because BOTH units are plausible for an Indian issuer and only the header line disambiguates.
traps.share_count_moved_after_last_balance_she: Shares issued were 3,04,53,000 at 31-Mar-2026 AND at 30-Jun-2026. The final 13,00,000 convertible warrants converted during FY2026-27, and the Board's Report (signed ~2026-08-20) states there are now no outstanding warrants - implying 3,17,53,000 shares today. No filed shareholding pattern yet reflects this (the next Reg-31 return is due for the quarter ending 30-Sep-2026). Consequence: the correct denominator for a per-share figure DEPENDS ON THE DATE, and the published data does not label which one it used. Market caps published on 2026-09-18 (76.37-76.94 cr) all imply the POST-conversion count; book value per share (8.52) implies the PRE-conversion count. Any tool that divides a published market cap by a published book value per share is mixing two different companies.
traps.basic_vs_diluted_faked_as_promoter_buyin: screener.in publishes 'Jun 2026: Promoters 37.66%' and 'Jul 2026: Promoters 40.21%' as two consecutive periods, and prints as a headline Pro: 'Promoter holding has increased by 2.55% over last quarter.' Both numbers come from the SAME filing - the shareholding pattern as on 30-Jun-2026 - where 37.6537% is column VIII (as a % of A+B+C2) and 40.2062% is column XII (assuming full conversion of convertible securities). 40.2062 - 37.6537 = 2.5525, exactly the '2.55%' screener attributes to promoter buying. NO promoter purchase occurred between those two 'quarters'; there is no July shareholding filing at all. INDmoney, Groww and Tickertape all carry the 40.21% figure labelled 'Aug 2026'. A terminal that surfaces 'promoter holding increased 2.55% last quarter' as a bullish signal is repeating a denominator change as an insider-buying event.
traps.tickertape_inverts_promoter_and_public: Tickertape prints 'Promoter Holding: 59.79%' and 'Retail & Others: 40.21%'. The filed pattern is the exact opposite: promoter & promoter group 37.6537% basic / 40.2062% diluted, public 62.3463% basic / 59.7938% diluted. Tickertape has assigned the PUBLIC diluted figure to promoters and the PROMOTER diluted figure to retail. Every other source (screener, INDmoney, Groww) says promoters hold 40.21%. Consequence: a research agent that samples Tickertape concludes the promoters hold a controlling ~60% stake when they hold ~40%; the direction of the last year's promoter-stake change also inverts.
traps.seventy_percent_phantom: The 2026-09-12 Reg 7(2) insider-trading disclosure is summarised on screener.in as 'Yash Khuteta acquired 21,000 shares via open market, taking holding to 70.23%.' The filed shareholding pattern as on 30-Jun-2026 shows Yash Khuteta holding 684,424 shares = 2.2475% of capital, and the ENTIRE promoter group at 37.65% basic / 40.21% diluted. 21,000 shares is 0.069% of the 3.04 crore share capital. No arithmetic takes a 2.25% holder to 70.23% on a 21,000-share purchase, and no single shareholder in the filing holds anything close to 70%. The 70.23% is therefore either a misparsed field from the Reg 7(2) form (which reports pre- and post-transaction holdings in both shares and percentages, plus percentages of the traded lot) or a hallucinated summary. BOTH readings are recorded with their as-of dates and NOT reconciled; the filing is the authority. This is the highest-severity diff target in this pack: a money-relevant control figure off by ~31x, published as prose next to a real filing date.
traps.five_sources_five_ratio_sets: For the SAME closing date (2026-09-18) the reachable aggregators publish: PE 29.69 (INDmoney) / 31.64 (Groww) / 32.1 (screener) / 35.29 (Tickertape); PB 1.77 (INDmoney) / 2.73 (Groww) / 2.84 (screener) / 2.96 (Tickertape); EPS 0.76 (Groww) / 0.78 (Tickertape) / 0.81 (screener); ROE 8.44% (Groww) / 10.1% (screener) / 10.12% (INDmoney); book value 8.52 (screener) / 8.82 (Groww); market cap 76 / 76.37 / 76.9 / 76.94 crore. Most of the spread is explained by the share-count ambiguity above, but INDmoney's PB of 1.77 could not be reconciled to any share count on any reported net worth. No source labels its denominator. A terminal that displays ONE of these as 'the' PE with no provenance is asserting a precision that does not exist at this market cap.
traps.name_lies_about_the_business: 'Continental SECURITIES Limited' with BSE scrip ID 'CSL' is an RBI-registered NBFC making MSME business loans, loans against property and gold loans in rural and semi-urban Rajasthan, plus mutual-fund distribution. It is not a broker and not an investment bank. Tickertape classifies it 'Financials | Investment Banking & Brokerage'; the CIN's 67120 code and the RBI CoR both say NBFC lending. A sector screen, a peer-set builder or a comparable-multiples table keyed on the name or on Tickertape's taxonomy will put it beside brokerages whose PE, PB and ROE conventions are unrelated to a lender's.
traps.ticker_collision_three_continents: CSL resolves to at least four distinct listed entities: (a) this company on BSE 538868; (b) Carlisle Companies Inc (NYSE:CSL), which is present in the app's own us_instruments.json; (c) CSL Limited (ASX:CSL), one of Australia's largest companies by market cap and by far the most-covered 'CSL' in world financial media; (d) historically The Container Store Group (NYSE:TCS/CSL coverage). Both sides of the US/India collision live INSIDE the product's bundled masters. A market cap of ~USD 100bn+ (CSL Ltd) versus ~INR 77 crore (~USD 9m) is a ~10,000x error if the wrong entity is resolved, and the currency differs too.
traps.pre_split_prices: Face value was sub-divided 1:5 from INR 10 to INR 2 (Tickertape dates it 2023-03-20). Archived quotes, screenshots and pre-2023 news carry prices 5x the current basis. Screener's own EPS series appears correctly restated (Mar-2023 EPS 0.30 on the post-split count), but a chart or news snippet sourced from before March 2023 without adjustment will show an apparent ~80% price collapse that never happened.
traps.nbfc_revenue_definition: 'Revenue' for this issuer has three defensible readings in one filing: Interest Income (INR 118.22 lakh for Q1 FY27), Total Income (INR 118.50 lakh, adding Other Operating Income), and screener's 'Financing Profit' line (INR 95 lakh, i.e. revenue net of expenses, which screener presents where an operating-profit row would sit for a non-financial). Screener's 'Revenue' row tracks INTEREST INCOME. At INR 4.22 crore TTM, a 0.6 lakh definitional difference is immaterial, but the SHAPE of the trap is not: the same page shows a 'Financing Margin' of 77.96% which a naive reader will compare against an operating margin from a manufacturer.
traps.zero_institutional_holding_is_real: FII, FPI (Cat I and II), mutual funds, banks, insurers, AIFs, pension and provident funds, and every other institutional line in the 30-Jun-2026 filing are all EXACTLY zero. This is a genuine value, not missing data. A UI that renders an absent institutional block as '-' or omits the section is indistinguishable from one that failed to fetch it; a screen that imputes a sector-median FII holding will invent foreign ownership in a company that has none.
traps.float_is_smaller_than_the_public_percent: The 62.35% 'public' holding includes three LLPs (Taarush Tradecom, Raahityaa Enterprises, Aahwaanith Tradecom) holding 16.14% between them, each parked just above the 5% disclosure line, plus Satiny Constructions Ltd at 3.28% and one locked-in individual at 2.15%. Real free float is materially below the headline public percentage, which matters at a INR 77 crore cap in BSE group X (illiquid).
traps.encumbrance_sits_with_the_public_not_the: Promoter pledge is exactly ZERO (confirmed in Table II and in the cover declaration). The 425,293 encumbered shares in this company are all PUBLIC holdings. A pipeline that reports a single 'shares pledged' number without the holder category would imply promoter leverage where there is none - the opposite of the usual Indian small-cap red flag.
traps.dividend_is_announced_but_not_yet_paid: As at this pack's collection date (2026-09-19) the FY2025-26 dividend of INR 0.05 is recommended but NOT approved: the AGM is 2026-09-28 and the record date 2026-09-21 is two days in the future. Screener shows a 0.21% yield, Groww and Tickertape 0.20%, INDmoney 0% - while INDmoney simultaneously prints 'Last Dividend Rs.0.05 per share (declared May 8, 2026)' on the same page. A 'dividend yield' shown without the approval status conflates a board recommendation with cash received.
traps.related_surname_concentration: The statutory auditor is R. P. Khandelwal & Associates (Jaipur); the Company Secretary and Compliance Officer is Pravita Khandelwal; the promoter group includes Madan Lal Khandelwal, Navneet Khandelwal, Radhika Khandelwal and Vikrant Khandelwal (4.47% combined); and an independent director is named Annu Sharma Khandelwal. Recorded as a verifiable observation from the filings, NOT as an assertion of any relationship or impropriety - surnames are common. Noted because a governance-screening agent will surface it and should be made to cite the filing rather than infer.
traps.stale_master_risk_is_low_here_but_group_: Unlike several battery names, CSL IS present in the app's bundled BSE master (538868 / CSL / group X / INE183Q01020 / Active) and the ISIN matches the company's own Annual Report exactly. The hazard in this name is not resolution failure but group X illiquidity plus the US collision: a resolver that falls back to the US master on a miss, or that prefers a higher-liquidity match, lands on Carlisle Companies.

world_gaps.ex_date_vs_record_date: The Annual Report gives a RECORD DATE of 2026-09-21 for the FY26 dividend. Tickertape publishes 2026-09-21 as the EX-DATE.
